Chandipura Virus Causes 22 Child Deaths in Gujarat Monsoon

Gujarat has reported 22 child deaths attributed to the Chandipura virus during the monsoon season. Health Minister Praful Panseriya stated that 184 suspected cases have been recorded, with 35 testing positive and 11 sample results pending. Seven children are currently under treatment. The virus has caused alarm, with reports detailing its symptoms and preventive measures.
